summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of IT Niche static landing page redesign. All 10 sections render, navigation/scroll works, hero infographic visible, services bento grid renders 6 cards, stats(4), process(4), capabilities pillars(6), both offices render, contact form static submit shows success toast and clears, mobile menu fully functional at 375px with no horizontal overflow. No console errors.
action_items: Optional/minor: Contact form fields use HTML5 `required` attribute, which causes the browser's native validation tooltip to appear (e.g. 'Please fill out this field') before the JS `onSubmit` validation can fire. As a result the custom sonner error toast 'Please fill in all required fields.' will NOT appear in normal user flow. If the spec requires the JS error toast to be the canonical empty-state UX, remove `required` from inputs and rely solely on the JS validation in Contact.jsx. If the native browser validation is acceptable, no action needed.

Optional: The valid-submission success toast text is 'Thanks! We\'ll be in touch shortly.' (with apostrophe) whereas the request statement specified 'Thanks! We will be in touch shortly.' — semantically equivalent and currently rendered correctly via sonner; verify which copy is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx: HTML5 `required` on inputs short-circuits the custom JS toast.error path — the empty-state error toast is effectively unreachable in normal UI. Decide on one validation strategy.
Landing.jsx is small/clean; all section components are properly isolated and use data-testid as documented — good testability.
No mongodb _id leakage (frontend-only static page) — N/A.
All section data-testids exist as documented in the review request — passes contract test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All sections render at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (375x844). All data-testids documented in the review_request exist. Header nav links and CTA scroll to correct sections. Contact form happy path works (success toast + form cleared). Empty-state JS error toast is only reachable if HTML5 `required` is removed (verified via JS removal). No console/page errors. Hero infographic, stat counts (20+, 500+, 98%, 2), 6 service cards, 4 process steps, 6 pillars, both office cards (USA Memphis, India Hyderabad), footer tagline + footer CTA all confirmed present.
